sources.name: NASA COOLR Global Landslide Catalog
sources.notes: DNS resolution failed or endpoint unreachable from this network. Download manually from https://gpm.nasa.gov/landslides/data.html

sources.name: ISRO/NRSC Landslide Atlas of India
sources.notes: No public API. Manual download from NRSC portal required. The ISRO Landslide Atlas (2023) is available as PDF with district-level statistics but not as a machine-readable event-level CSV. Contact: nrsc-disastermanagement@gov.in

sources.name: Open-Meteo ERA5 Historical Archive
sources.license: ERA5: CC BY 4.0 (Copernicus/ECMWF); Open-Meteo service: MIT

sources.name: ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0
sources.notes: Skipped via --skip-soilgrids flag to reduce runtime.

sources.name: OpenTopography SRTM 30m
sources.license: SRTM: Public Domain; OpenTopography service: Academic
sources.notes: API key required. Register at https://portal.opentopography.org/. Once key obtained, set environment variable OPENTOPO_API_KEY. Can provide: elevation, slope, aspect (30m SRTM) for NER bbox. Manual download alternative: https://dwtkns.com/srtm30m/

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR (InSAR deformation)
sources.notes: ESA registration required. Provides: ground_displacement (InSAR). Alternative: ASF DAAC (https://search.asf.alaska.edu/) for NER time series.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Multispectral (NDVI/land cover)
sources.notes: ESA registration required. Provides: NDVI, land_cover. Alternative: Google Earth Engine free tier for NER NDVI time series.
